_authority: OW-17 amendment (c); method record section 17; close-gate item 23

_fields.proposer: the execution id of the proposing subagent
_fields.target_section: section of the method record the change applies to, or NEW
_fields.change: the text that would appear, not a description of it
_fields.evidence_from_this_book: exact artefact references; a proposal without book evidence is inadmissible
_fields.cost_to_adopt: including any tool, brief or validator that must change
_fields.adjudication: null until adjudicated, then {verdict: ADOPT|REJECT|DEFER, rating: NECESSARY|USEFUL|LOW_REWARD, by, at, reasons}
_fields.landed_in_version: the method version that carries it, or null

_rules: the proposer never edits the method record
the adjudicator is never the proposer and never the orchestrator that ran the book
rejected and deferred proposals are KEPT with their reasons - a rejected proposal is evidence
a book closes only when every proposal from it is adjudicated
